name: repeat-suppression
description: A sprint check-in where the new API rate limit (120 requests/minute) is stated early. Ten minutes after the coach answers the first 'what was the cap again?', a late joiner asks the same question. A good companion never repeats a card it has already shown — silence beats repetition.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sprint check-in. Platform first, then mobile, then the grab bag.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Platform's mostly the rate-limit rollout this week.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Heads-up for everyone: the new public API rate limit went live this morning — a hundred and twenty requests per minute per key, with burst up to two hundred for thirty seconds.

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: Curious whether the big integrators have noticed yet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Two support tickets so far, both resolved by pointing at the retry-after header.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Good. The docs page went out with the changelog as well.

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: Mobile side: the offline sync spike finished, write-ups going into the wiki today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Lovely. Anything blocking the beta cut, Ade?

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: Just the build signing, and that's on me. Done by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: I'm meeting the design agency at three, so I'll drop off early today.

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: Wait — what did we cap the public API at again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Hundred and twenty a minute, burst two hundred. It's in the changelog.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: And the enterprise keys are exempt until January, don't forget.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Right. Grab bag: the office move is confirmed for the last weekend of October.

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: I'll believe the move when I see the boxes.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Fair. Facilities swears this time it's real.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: On hiring — the staff engineer loop finished, debrief is Friday.

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: The take-home feedback was strong, for what it's worth.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Good sign. Let's keep the loop tight — we've lost candidates to slow debriefs before.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Agreed. Support rota: the November pairs go out this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: Swap me off the first weekend if you can, I'm away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Noted. I'll take it.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Status page revamp shipped quietly on Monday, by the way. Uptime history is public now.

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: Saw that — looks much cleaner.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Marketing wants a blog post on the API changes for the developer newsletter.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: I can review a draft if someone writes it.

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: I'll take the first pass — it's mostly the changelog with sentences.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Perfect.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Last call for the grab bag, then.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Nothing more from me.

utterances.speaker: Ade
utterances.text: One thing, actually — Marcus just joined, give him a second.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: Sorry all, I was double-booked and only just made it. Quick one — what's the rate limit on the public API now?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Hundred and twenty a minute, Marcus. The changelog has the details.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Right, we're done. Thanks all.
